## Installation

Download `PlayerRoleOptions.zip` and extract to your `World of Warcraft/_anniversary_/Interface/AddOns/` directory.

## Usage

Right-click another player in your party or raid to assign `Tank`, `Healer`, `DPS`, or clear their role.
